rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP. LXIII. Of Theft.
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: A numbered original section concerning the proposed astrological significator of a thief.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Source starts PDF428 below LXII divider; no dog-case text included.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: received opinion of Master Allen of Oxford
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The author initially summarizes a method attributed to Master Allen of Oxford.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Attributed earlier doctrine, separate from Lilly own competing preference.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: peregrine Planet in an angle or second house
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Allen is quoted as selecting a peregrine planet in an angle or second house.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Additional seventh-house aspect condition must be retained.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: and beholds seventh house
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The chosen planet is required to behold the seventh house under the first rule.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Do not accept any angular peregrine without this condition.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if no peregrine Planet be in angle or second
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: When none meets the initial criteria, the seventh lord becomes a candidate.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Fallback includes seventh lord beholding the seventh.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of seventh ... behold seventh
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The fallback seventh-house ruler also must aspect its own house in this formulation.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Original source order controls alternative.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: otherwise Planet to whom Moon applyes
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Failing the seventh ruler, the planet to which the Moon applies can signify thief.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Original adds its own condition beholding seventh.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if he behold seventh house
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The Moon-applied planet is conditioned on beholding the seventh.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Do not omit scope.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: rather if Moon separate from Lord of ascendant
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: A separation from the ascendant lord introduces a competing lunar relation in the printed text.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Grammatical attachment to prior option unresolved.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: peregrine in angle shall not signify thief unlesse behold seventh or have dignity degree seventh
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Allen demands seventh-aspect or dignity in seventh degree despite peregrine angular position.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Preserve explicit disjunction of aspect or dignity.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: same Planet Lord of hour and of ascendant
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Allen also lists identity of hour lord and ascendant lord as exception to prior constraints.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Original wording seemingly refers to beholding ascendant, not seventh; do not repair.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: I have ever found ... peregrine in ascendant
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly states his own preference for peregrine planet in the first house.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Competing source-native preference, not independently verified outcome.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: next angle South ... West ... fourth ... second
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: He orders alternative placements as southern angle, western angle, fourth house, then second house.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Do not collapse south and fourth into one heading without source explanation.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: many peregrine Planets in angles, many suspected
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: He conjectures many suspects when several angular peregrines appear.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Mistrust, suspicion and guilt are not independently established.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: conjunction sextile trine ... agreeing; square opposition ... nonconsenting
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Aspect condition is associated with suspects acting together or not agreeing.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Attribution and original grammar span PDF428 to PDF429; retain aspect polarity.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ever prefer peregrine nearest cusp of angle
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: He says to prioritize the peregrine planet nearest the cusp of its angular house.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: No numeric closeness threshold or deterministic calculation given.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Money lost, who stole it? if recoverable?
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: A new unnumbered worked money-loss inquiry begins inside Chapter LXIII.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Not new numbered chapter, and not fish-theft case.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: original round horoscope 24 May 1647
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The original circular horoscope gives 24 May 1647 and chart house/planet placements.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Figure has uncertain additional hour characters and no independently verified calculation.

rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The date printed inside the money-loss figure is 24 May 1647.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Do not conflate with a 1638 fish chart on following page.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Judgment upon this Figure
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The worked judgment of the theft figure begins below it on PDF429.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Narrative is source-internal and retrospective.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars here ascends and partly represents querent person
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars is associated with ascendant and questioner.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Mars is not thereby established thief significator.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars mind and disposition ... square Mercury and Saturn
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The author characterizes querent as arrogant, proud, wasteful and ill-conditioned.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Unverified and ethically unsuitable accusations against historical person.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars 25 degrees 2 minutes Leo angular
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars is described angular in Leo at approximately 25 degrees 2 minutes.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Original printed degrees and planetary placement authoritative; no independent ephemeris parity.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: in own Terms and Decanate
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: His terms and decan status lead author to refuse Mars for thief identification.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Counterexample to simplistic malefic angular thief inference.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn angle of West
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn is also placed in the western angle.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Angular status alone not proof of thief role.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn own Terms and Decanate
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The author passes over Saturn because it has its own terms and decan dignity.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Not proof of actual innocence.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury 24 degrees 42 Taurus
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury is described at roughly 24 degrees 42 Taurus.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: No independent ephemeris parity.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury lately square Mars, almost conjunct Saturn
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The source describes prior square with Mars and near conjunction with Saturn.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Original includes editorial correction of aspect wording.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury peregrine, no essential dignity
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly selects Mercury as thief significator based on lack of dignity.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Historical author inference, not established criminal evidence.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: dispute whether Mercury Male or Female
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The author says the alleged thief sex was disputed.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Original angles have mixed masculine and feminine testimony.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon masculine and applying masculine Planet in masculine Sign
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: He uses lunar and planetary masculinity testimony to favor male.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Mercury is described as changeable in nature.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: from hence Sex to be Male
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly concludes the suspected thief is male.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Not independently validated human inference.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: young Youth fifteen or sixteen
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: A youth of about 15–16 is proposed.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Mercury youth symbolism plus Moon near Sun cited.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: thin visaged, hanging eyebrows, long forehead
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The suspected youth is described with specific facial features.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Unverified astrological physiognomy.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: scars face, poor eyesight, dark hair
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The source adds scarring, eyesight and hair conjectures.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Fixed-star claims are historical, not health diagnostics.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: scurvy countenance and suspected before
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly suggests the boy looked untrustworthy and had prior suspicion.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: No independent criminal history; do not validate accusation.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury with Saturn lord third and fourth
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The author infers the suspected youth is a neighbor’s child.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Rulership assignment in original chart unverified independently.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon Gemini and Mercury Taurus, opposite or Southwest
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: He proposes residence opposite the querent or toward southwest.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Original alternatives kept; location not externally authenticated.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortune rising, Mars in tenth, Moon sextile within four degrees
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: He uses Fortune and Moon applying sextile to Mars with four-degree separation.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Source geometric claims not independently reconstructed.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: hear of or recover Money within four days
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly predicts learning about or regaining lost money within four days.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Disjunctive hearing-versus-actual-return forecast.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: questioner favored Woman-servant and Saturn person
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: The querent reportedly challenged Lilly and suspected other people.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: No authenticated criminal findings about any person.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: refused both suspects as planets dignified
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly rejected alternative suspects because their significators were dignified.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Internal case narrative, not external guilt proof.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: money returned within three days
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: He claims the stolen money was returned within three days and his description was correct.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: One author-reported result, not a prospectively frozen independent accuracy validation.

rows.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP LIV. Fish Stolen.
rows.historical_author_paraphrase: A separate worked stolen-fish horoscope begins original PDF431/printed397.
rows.source_conditions_and_uncertainty: Literal numeral LIV is printed, although its sequential position after LXIII corresponds to expected LXIV; navigation only, no fish case content.
